rejectedAndSeparatedEvidence.result: 158 failed requests in 3116; routing/socket interruption during native regeneration; retained as failed-before evidence.
Foreground requests survived but a truly timed post-response job did not complete under the native ten-second master control grace. Rejected; not shipped.

All 67 fixture stages passed, then an unrecorded public warmup assertion after a deliberate maintenance transition aborted the complete run. Its paired website comparison was not accepted. Six separately repeated logged paired trials and six genuine cold public starts passed.
Signal-interrupted sleep returned early. Excluded as proof of the requested background duration; replaced with a monotonic deadline loop and elapsed-time assertion.

remainingBoundaries: Clean-OS installation requires a disposable host, which the owner does not have. Existing-host lifecycle evidence is retained separately.
Unknown future vendor behavior or changed hardware/data/workload requires renewed checks.
Explicit restart, changed routing and resource downgrades remain maintenance operations. Graceful reload may delay queued work; strict test maximum was about 20.8 seconds.
Shared SQL and owner-selected Shared Redis are shared services, not per-tenant database/cache isolation.
Synthetic requests and HTML-only BDT-cookie comparisons are not a maximum checkout/shopper claim.
